name: THNHC appointments
intro: See your appointments and room blocks in the calendar you already use on your phone or computer. Choose your calendar app below. You only need to do this once.
introAdmin: See who uses which room, and when, in the calendar you already use on your phone or computer. Choose your calendar app below. You only need to do this once.
delay: Your calendar app checks for changes by itself. New bookings can take a few hours to appear in Google Calendar. This calendar is for viewing only: make changes here, in the portal.
otherText: Copy this link and add it in your calendar app as a subscription (often called “Add calendar from URL” or “Subscribe”).
privacy: Keep this link to yourself. Anyone who has it can see your appointments: the client's first name and the treatment, never their complaint.
privacyAdmin: Keep this link to yourself. Anyone who has it can see the room schedule: therapist names and times, no client details.
resetTitle: Lost the link or shared it by mistake?
resetText: Make a new link. The old one stops working straight away, so you'll need to add the calendar again with one of the buttons above.
resetDone: Done: you have a new link. Add it to your calendar again with one of the buttons below.
resetError: That didn't work. Please try again, or call us and we'll help.
